                AWS automatically provisions infrastructure.
                
                Container starts running.
                
                ---
                
                # What You DO NOT Manage
                
                With Fargate you NEVER manage:
                
                - EC2 instances
                - ECS agent
                - Docker daemon
                - OS patches
                - Infrastructure scaling
                - Server failures
                
                This is why it is called:
                
                ```
                Serverless containers
                ```
                
                ---
                
                # Fargate Internals
                
                Even though you don't see servers:
                
                ```
                Containers STILL run on servers internally
                ```
                
                AWS simply hides and manages them for you.
                
                ---
                
                # Fargate Networking
                
                VERY important.
                
                Fargate requires:
                
                ```
                awsvpc network mode
                ```
                
                Meaning:
                
                ```
                Each task gets its own ENI and private IP
                ```
                
                ---
                
                # Example
                
                ```
                Task A → 10.0.1.5
                Task B → 10.0.1.8
                ```
                
                Tasks behave almost like mini virtual machines.
                
                ---
                
                # Strong Isolation
                
                One huge advantage.
                
                Each Fargate task has strong isolation between workloads.
                
                Better security compared to shared EC2 hosts.
                
                ---
                
                # Resource Configuration
                
                You define:
                
                - CPU
                - Memory
                
                Example:
                
                ```
                0.5 vCPU
                1GB RAM
                ```
                
                AWS allocates required infrastructure automatically.
                
                ---
                
                # Supported CPU/Memory Combinations
                
                Fargate only allows valid combinations.
                
                Example:
                
                | CPU | Allowed Memory |
                | --- | --- |
                | 256 | 512MB–2GB |
                | 512 | 1GB–4GB |
                | 1024 | 2GB–8GB |
                
                ---
                
                # Fargate Scaling
                
                Very easy.
                
                ECS simply launches more tasks.
                
                Example:
                
                ```
                2 Tasks
                →
                10 Tasks
                ```
                
                No server management needed.
                
                ---
                
                # High Availability
                
                Fargate tasks can automatically spread across:
                
                - Availability Zones
                - Subnets
                
                Example:
                
                ```
                AZ-A → 2 tasks
                AZ-B → 2 tasks
                ```
                
                ---
                
                # Fargate Pricing
                
                You pay for:
                
                - CPU
                - Memory
                - Runtime duration
                
                NOT for EC2 instances.
                
                ---
                
                # Important Difference
                
                EC2 pricing:
                
                ```
                Pay for server even if idle
                ```
                
                Fargate pricing:
                
                ```
                Pay per running task resources
                ```
                
                ---
                
                # Fargate Spot
                
                Cheaper version of Fargate.
                
                Uses spare AWS capacity.
                
                Can be interrupted.
                
                Best for:
                
                - Workers
                - Batch jobs
                - Non-critical workloads
                
                ---
                
                # Common Use Cases
                
                Fargate is VERY popular for:
                
                | Use Case | Why |
                | --- | --- |
                | APIs | Simple deployment |
                | Microservices | Easy scaling |
                | Background workers | Fast setup |
                | Startups | Low operational overhead |
                | Internal tools | Minimal DevOps |
                
                ---
                
                # Logging
                
                Usually integrated with:
                
                Amazon CloudWatch
                
                Example:
                
                ```
                Container logs
                → CloudWatch Logs
                ```
                
                ---
                
                # IAM Integration
                
                Fargate tasks support:
                
                ```
                Task IAM Roles
                ```
                
                Your app can securely access:
                
                - S3
                - SQS
                - DynamoDB
                - Secrets Manager
                
                without hardcoded credentials.
                
                ---
                
                # Storage
                
                By default:
                
                ```
                Ephemeral storage
                ```
                
                Meaning:
                
                ```
                Data disappears when task stops
                ```
                
                For persistence use:
                
                - S3
                - RDS
                - EFS
                
                ---
                
                # Fargate vs EC2
                
                | Feature | Fargate | EC2 |
                | --- | --- | --- |
                | Server management | AWS | You |
                | Simplicity | Very high | Medium |
                | Cost efficiency at scale | Lower | Higher |
                | Control | Limited | Full |
                | Operational overhead | Very low | Higher |
                
                ---
                
                # Limitations of Fargate
                
                ---
                
                ## Less Host Control
                
                Cannot:
                
                - SSH into host
                - Customize kernel
                - Install host software
                
                ---
                
                ## More Expensive
                
                Usually more expensive than EC2 at very large scale.
                
                ---
                
                ## Some Advanced Features Limited
                
                Compared to EC2:
                
                - GPU support
                - Deep networking customization
                - Specialized workloads
                
                ---
                
                # Best Practice Recommendation
                
                For most modern applications:
                
                ```
                Start with Fargate
                ```
                
                Then optimize later if needed.
                
                ---
                
                # Common Beginner Mistakes
                
                ---
                
                ## Mistake 1
                
                Thinking Fargate has no servers at all.
                
                Wrong.
                
                AWS manages hidden infrastructure.
                
                ---
                
                ## Mistake 2
                
                Trying to SSH into Fargate.
                
                No direct host access.
                
                ---
                
                ## Mistake 3
                
                Storing important data inside container filesystem.
                
                Containers are ephemeral.
                
                ---
                
                # Real Production Architecture
                
                ```
                Users
                   ↓
                Application Load Balancer
                   ↓
                ECS Service
                   ↓
                Fargate Tasks
                   ↓
                RDS / Redis / S3
                ```
                
                ---
                
                # Interview Question
                
                ## Question
                
                What problem does AWS Fargate solve?
                
                ## Answer
                
                Fargate removes the need to manage container infrastructure like EC2 servers, Docker hosts, and scaling, allowing developers to run containers in a serverless way.
                
                ---
                
                # Mental Model
                
                ```
                EC2 ECS
                   = You manage restaurant building
                
                Fargate
                   = AWS owns building, you only cook food
                ```

        - ECR Amazon ECR (Elastic Container Registry)
            - 1. Introduction to ECR
                - 1.1 What is ECR
                    
                    # 1.1 What is Amazon ECR?
                    
                    ECR (**Elastic Container Registry**) is an AWS service that stores and manages **Docker container images**.
                    
                    Think:
                    
                    ```
                    Source Code
                       ↓
                    docker build
                       ↓
                    Docker Image
                       ↓
                    Push to ECR
                       ↓
                    ECS / EC2 / Lambda pulls image
                       ↓
                    Application runs
                    ```
                    
                    ECR itself **does not run containers**.
                    
                    Its only responsibility is:
                    
                    - Store images
                    - Version images
                    - Secure images
                    - Deliver images to compute services
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Why ECR Exists
                    
                    Imagine you built this:
                    
                    ```
                    NestJS Backend
                    React Frontend
                    Postgres
                    ```
                    
                    You create:
                    
                    ```
                    docker build-t backend .
                    ```
                    
                    Now you have:
                    
                    ```
                    backend:latest
                    ```
                    
                    Question:
                    
                    Where do you store it?
                    
                    Options:
                    
                    - Docker Hub
                    - GitHub Registry
                    - AWS ECR ← AWS solution
                    
                    ECR is AWS's answer.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Real Production Flow
                    
                    Imagine your CRM project.
                    
                    You write:
                    
                    ```
                    NestJS
                    ↓
                    docker build
                    ↓
                    backend:v1
                    ↓
                    docker push ECR
                    ↓
                    ECS pulls
                    ↓
                    Container starts
                    ```
                    
                    You never upload:
                    
                    ```
                    app.ts
                    controller.ts
                    service.ts
                    ```
                    
                    You upload:
                    
                    ```
                    Entire packaged environment
                    ```
                    
                    Inside image:
                    
                    ```
                    Node
                    NestJS
                    Dependencies
                    Built app
                    Configs
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Core Components
                    
                    ### 1. Registry
                    
                    Top-level storage.
                    
                    Example:
                    
                    ```
                    AWS Account
                    └── Registry
                    ```
                    
                    One registry per region/account.
                    
                    Example:
                    
                    ```
                    123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ### 2. Repository
                    
                    Folder for images.
                    
                    Example:
                    
                    ```
                    backend
                    frontend
                    payment-service
                    ```
                    
                    Repository:
                    
                    ```
                    backend
                    ```
                    
                    Contains:
                    
                    ```
                    backend:v1
                    backend:v2
                    backend:latest
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ### 3. Image
                    
                    Actual deployable package.
                    
                    Example:
                    
                    ```
                    backend:v2
                    ```
                    
                    Contains:
                    
                    ```
                    Linux
                    Node
                    node_modules
                    dist/
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Important Distinction
                    
                    Many beginners confuse this.
                    
                    ```
                    Dockerfile
                    ≠
                    Docker Image
                    ≠
                    Container
                    ```
                    
                    ### Dockerfile
                    
                    Instructions.
                    
                    ```
                    FROM node:22
                    COPY .
                    RUN npm install
                    ```
                    
                    ↓
                    
                    ### Docker Image
                    
                    Built artifact.
                    
                    ```
                    backend:v1
                    ```
                    
                    ↓
                    
                    ### Container
                    
                    Running process.
                    
                    ```
                    Container ID
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # ECR in AWS Ecosystem
                    
                    ```
                    Code
                     ↓
                    CodeBuild / GitHub Actions
                     ↓
                    Docker Build
                     ↓
                    ECR
                     ↓
                    ECS
                     ↓
                    ALB
                     ↓
                    Users
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Very Important (Interview Level)
                    
                    If interviewer asks:
                    
                    > "What is ECR?"
                    > 
                    
                    Good answer:
                    
                    > ECR is AWS managed container registry used to store, version and distribute container images. Services like ECS, EKS, EC2 and Lambda can pull images from ECR and run containers.
                    > 
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # One line to remember
                    
                    > **ECR stores images. ECS runs images.**
                    > 
                - 1.2 Why ECR Exists
                    
                    Perfect. This section is where ECR starts making sense.
                    
                    # 1.2 Why ECR Exists
                    
                    Question:
                    
                    > Docker can already build images. Why do we need ECR?
                    > 
                    
                    Because **Docker builds images locally but does not solve centralized storage and deployment.**
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Problem Without ECR
                    
                    Imagine your project.
                    
                    You build:
                    
                    ```bash
                    docker build -t backend:v1 .
                    ```
                    
                    Now image exists only here:
                    
                    ```
                    Muzaffar's MacBook
                    ```
                    
                    Question:
                    
                    How will ECS in AWS get this image?
                    
                    It cannot.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Problem 1 — Images stay local
                    
                    Without registry:
                    
                    ```
                    Laptop
                    └── backend:v1
                    ```
                    
                    Production server:
                    
                    ```
                    ❌ cannot access
                    ```
                    
                    Need:
                    
                    ```
                    Laptop
                     ↓
                    Push
                     ↓
                    Central Storage
                     ↓
                    Server Pull
                    ```
                    
                    That storage is:
                    
                    ```
                    ECR
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Problem 2 — Multiple Servers Need Same Image
                    
                    Imagine:
                    
                    ```
                    ECS Service
                     ├── Task 1
                     ├── Task 2
                     ├── Task 3
                    ```
                    
                    All need:
                    
                    ```
                    backend:v5
                    ```
                    
                    Without registry:
                    
                    ```
                    copy manually ❌
                    ```
                    
                    With ECR:
                    
                    ```
                    Task 1 → Pull
                    Task 2 → Pull
                    Task 3 → Pull
                    ```
                    
                    Same image.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Problem 3 — Version Management
                    
                    Imagine:
                    
                    ```
                    backend:v1
                    backend:v2
                    backend:v3
                    ```
                    
                    Production currently:
                    
                    ```
                    v2
                    ```
                    
                    New deployment:
                    
                    ```
                    v3
                    ```
                    
                    Bug appears.
                    
                    Rollback:
                    
                    ```
                    v2
                    ```
                    
                    Registry enables:
                    
                    ```
                    store
                    version
                    rollback
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Problem 4 — CI/CD Needs Shared Storage
                    
                    Imagine GitHub Actions.
                    
                    Developer:
                    
                    ```
                    git push
                    ```
                    
                    Pipeline:
                    
                    ```
                    Build Docker Image
                    ↓
                    Push ECR
                    ↓
                    Deploy ECS
                    ```
                    
                    Without ECR:
                    
                    ```
                    CI builds image
                    but nowhere to store
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Problem 5 — ECS Needs Pull Source
                    
                    Remember yesterday.
                    
                    Task Definition:
                    
                    ```json
                    {
                     "image":
                     "123.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/backend:v2"
                    }
                    ```
                    
                    ECS does:
                    
                    ```
                    Start Task
                    ↓
                    Read image
                    ↓
                    Download image
                    ↓
                    Run container
                    ```
                    
                    Without ECR:
                    
                    ```
                    No image
                    No container
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Problem 6 — Security
                    
                    ECR integrates with:
                    
                    - IAM
                    - VPC
                    - Encryption
                    - Vulnerability scanning
                    
                    Example:
                    
                    ```
                    Developer
                       ↓
                    Push Allowed
                    
                    Random User
                       ↓
                    Access Denied
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Real Flow
                    
                    Without ECR:
                    
                    ```
                    Mac
                    ↓
                    docker build
                    ↓
                    ???
                    ↓
                    Production
                    ```
                    
                    Broken.
                    
                    With ECR:
                    
                    ```
                    Mac
                    ↓
                    docker build
                    ↓
                    docker push
                    ↓
                    ECR
                    ↓
                    ECS pull
                    ↓
                    Container running
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Simple Analogy
                    
                    ```
                    Docker → creates movie
                    
                    ECR → Netflix storage
                    
                    ECS → TV that plays movie
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Interview Question
                    
                    **Why not upload source code directly to ECS?**
                    
                    Answer:
                    
                    Because ECS runs containers, not source code. Source code must first be packaged into Docker images and stored in ECR.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # One sentence to remember
                    
                    > Docker creates images. ECR distributes images. ECS executes images.
                    > 
                    
                    Next:
                    
                    **1.3 ECR vs Docker Hub** (this one is important because interviewers love asking it).
                    
                - 1.3 ECR vs Docker Hub
                    
                    Good. This one is interview-favorite because people often think:
                    
                    > Docker Hub = ECR
                    > 
                    
                    Not exactly.
                    
                    # 1.3 ECR vs Docker Hub
                    
                    First understand:
                    
                    Both do the same high-level job:
                    
                    > Store Docker images.
                    > 
                    
                    But they are optimized for different ecosystems.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Quick Comparison
                    
                    | Feature | ECR | Docker Hub |
                    | --- | --- | --- |
                    | Owner | AWS | Docker |
                    | Purpose | AWS container registry | General container registry |
                    | Authentication | IAM | Docker accounts |
                    | ECS Integration | Native | Manual |
                    | EKS Integration | Native | Manual |
                    | Private repos | Strong support | Supported |
                    | Image scanning | Built-in | Available |
                    | Network speed in AWS | Usually better | External |
                    | Pricing | Pay for storage/usage | Free + paid tiers |
                    | Production AWS usage | Very common | Common but less AWS-native |
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Mental Model
                    
                    ### Docker Hub
                    
                    Like:
                    
                    ```
                    GitHub
                    ```
                    
                    Public place.
                    
                    Anyone can publish images.
                    
                    Example:
                    
                    ```bash
                    docker pull node
                    docker pull postgres
                    docker pull nginx
                    ```
                    
                    Those usually come from Docker Hub.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ### ECR
                    
                    Like:
                    
                    ```
                    Private company GitHub
                    inside AWS
                    ```
                    
                    Store your production images.
                    
                    Example:
                    
                    ```
                    crm-backend:v1
                    payment-service:v4
                    frontend:v12
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Architecture Comparison
                    
                    ## Docker Hub
                    
                    ```
                    Developer
                     ↓
                    docker push
                     ↓
                    Docker Hub
                     ↓
                    AWS ECS
                     ↓
                    pull image
                    ```
                    
                    External dependency.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ## ECR
                    
                    ```
                    Developer
                     ↓
                    docker push
                     ↓
                    ECR
                     ↓
                    ECS
                     ↓
                    run
                    ```
                    
                    Everything stays inside AWS.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Example
                    
                    You create image:
                    
                    ```bash
                    docker build -t backend:v1 .
                    ```
                    
                    Push to Docker Hub:
                    
                    ```bash
                    docker push muzaffar/backend:v1
                    ```
                    
                    Image:
                    
                    ```
                    docker.io/muzaffar/backend:v1
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    Push to ECR:
                    
                    ```bash
                    docker push \
                    123456.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/backend:v1
                    ```
                    
                    Image:
                    
                    ```
                    123456.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/backend:v1
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Authentication Difference
                    
                    ## Docker Hub
                    
                    Login:
                    
                    ```bash
                    docker login
                    ```
                    
                    Uses:
                    
                    ```
                    username
                    password
                    token
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ## ECR
                    
                    Login:
                    
                    ```bash
                    aws ecr get-login-password
                    ```
                    
                    Uses:
                    
                    ```
                    IAM
                    AWS credentials
                    roles
                    ```
                    
                    This becomes powerful in ECS.
                    
                    Example:
                    
                    ```
                    ECS Task Role
                    ↓
                    Pull ECR
                    ↓
                    No password stored
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Production Example
                    
                    Your future deployment:
                    
                    ```
                    GitHub
                     ↓
                    GitHub Actions
                     ↓
                    Build Docker Image
                     ↓
                    Push ECR
                     ↓
                    ECS Deploy
                     ↓
                    ALB
                     ↓
                    Users
                    ```
                    
                    You usually will not insert Docker Hub here.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # So why does Docker Hub still exist?
                    
                    Because AWS is not always used.
                    
                    Examples:
                    
                    ```
                    Local Development
                    Open Source
                    Learning
                    Multi-cloud
                    ```
                    
                    People often pull:
                    
                    ```
                    node
                    mongo
                    redis
                    postgres
                    ```
                    
                    from Docker Hub.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # When to Choose What
                    
                    Choose **Docker Hub** when:
                    
                    ✅ Learning
                    
                    ✅ Public images
                    
                    ✅ Open source
                    
                    Choose **ECR** when:
                    
                    ✅ ECS
                    
                    ✅ EKS
                    
                    ✅ Production AWS
                    
                    ✅ Private deployments
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Interview Question
                    
                    > If ECS can pull from Docker Hub, why use ECR?
                    > 
                    
                    Answer:
                    
                    Because ECR provides tighter AWS integration, IAM security, easier deployments, lower operational overhead, and optimized access from AWS services.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # One sentence to remember
                    
                    > Docker Hub is general storage for container images. ECR is AWS-native storage for container images.
                    > 
                    
                    Next:
                    
                    **1.4 Where ECR fits inside AWS architecture** → after this ECR will start connecting to ECS, ALB, Lambda, API Gateway in your head.
                    
                - 1.4 Where ECR Fits Inside AWS Architecture
                    
                    Perfect. This is the section that connects yesterday’s ECS learning with today’s ECR.
                    
                    # 1.4 Where ECR Fits Inside AWS Architecture
                    
                    Question:
                    
                    > We learned ECS yesterday.
                    > 
                    > 
                    > We learned ECR today.
                    > 
                    > Now where exactly does ECR sit?
                    > 
                    
                    Short answer:
                    
                    > **ECR sits between Build and Deployment.**
                    > 
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # High-Level AWS Deployment Flow
                    
                    ```
                    Developer
                       ↓
                    Write Code
                       ↓
                    Build Docker Image
                       ↓
                    ECR
                       ↓
                    ECS
                       ↓
                    Load Balancer
                       ↓
                    Users
                    ```
                    
                    Meaning:
                    
                    ```
                    Code
                    → Package
                    → Store
                    → Execute
                    → Serve
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Real AWS Architecture
                    
                    ```
                    Browser
                       ↓
                    ALB
                    (Application Load Balancer)
                       ↓
                    ECS Service
                       ↓
                    ECS Tasks
                       ↓
                    Containers
                       ↑
                    Pull Images
                       ↑
                    ECR
                    ```
                    
                    Notice:
                    
                    ECR is **not in request path**.
                    
                    Users never talk to ECR.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Request Path vs Deployment Path
                    
                    This distinction is VERY important.
                    
                    ## Runtime Request Flow
                    
                    (User traffic)
                    
                    ```
                    User
                     ↓
                    Load Balancer
                     ↓
                    Container
                     ↓
                    Database
                    ```
                    
                    No ECR.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ## Deployment Flow
                    
                    (New release)
                    
                    ```
                    Developer
                     ↓
                    docker build
                     ↓
                    docker push
                     ↓
                    ECR
                     ↓
                    ECS deploy
                     ↓
                    Task pulls image
                     ↓
                    Container starts
                    ```
                    
                    ECR appears here.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Let's Follow a Real Deployment
                    
                    Imagine your CRM.
                    
                    You changed:
                    
                    ```
                    UsersController
                    ```
                    
                    and push code.
                    
                    ### Step 1 — Build
                    
                    ```bash
                    docker build -t crm:v5 .
                    ```
                    
                    Produces:
                    
                    ```
                    crm:v5
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ### Step 2 — Store
                    
                    ```bash
                    docker push ECR
                    ```
                    
                    Now:
                    
                    ```
                    ECR
                    └── crm:v5
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ### Step 3 — Deploy
                    
                    ECS Service updates.
                    
                    Task Definition:
                    
                    ```json
                    {
                     "image":
                     "ecr/crm:v5"
                    }
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ### Step 4 — Pull
                    
                    Task starts.
                    
                    ```
                    ECS Agent
                    ↓
                    Call ECR
                    ↓
                    Download image
                    ↓
                    Start container
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    ### Step 5 — Serve Traffic
                    
                    Now:
                    
                    ```
                    User
                    ↓
                    ALB
                    ↓
                    ECS
                    ↓
                    Container(v5)
                    ```
                    
                    Again:
                    
                    No ECR.
                    
                    Because image is already downloaded.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # ECR Relationships with AWS Services
                    
                    | Service | Relationship |
                    | --- | --- |
                    | ECS | Pulls images |
                    | EC2 | Pulls images |
                    | Lambda | Can run container images |
                    | EKS | Pulls images |
                    | CodeBuild | Pushes images |
                    | CodePipeline | Automates deployment |
                    | IAM | Controls access |
                    | CloudWatch | Logs deployment |
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Architecture You Will See Most
                    
                    ```
                    GitHub
                     ↓
                    GitHub Actions
                     ↓
                    Build
                     ↓
                    ECR
                     ↓
                    ECS
                     ↓
                    ALB
                     ↓
                    Users
                     ↓
                    RDS
                    ```
                    
                    This is extremely common.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Important Observation
                    
                    Yesterday you learned:
                    
                    ```
                    Cluster
                    Service
                    Task
                    Container
                    ```
                    
                    Today add:
                    
                    ```
                    Image
                    Repository
                    Registry
                    ```
                    
                    Full chain:
                    
                    ```
                    Image
                    ↓
                    ECR
                    ↓
                    Task Definition
                    ↓
                    Task
                    ↓
                    Service
                    ↓
                    Cluster
                    ↓
                    ALB
                    ↓
                    Users
                    ```
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # Interview Question
                    
                    > Does ECS store images?
                    > 
                    
                    Answer:
                    
                    No.
                    
                    ECS orchestrates containers.
                    
                    Images are stored in ECR.
                    
                    ---
                    
                    # One sentence to remember
                    
                    > ECR is storage between Docker build and ECS execution.
                    > 
                    
                    Now ECR foundation is done.

                    # 2. Core ECR Concepts
                    
                    - 2.1 Registry
                    - 2.2 Repository
                    - 2.3 Image
                    - 2.4 Tags
